title: Use only the reconciliation marker for controller ownership and refuse adopting tenantless connectors
summary: Remove CONTROLLER_OWNED_CONNECTOR_IDS and every reference to it so controller ownership is governed solely by the single canonical persona_source_reconciliation marker (managed_by=persona_source_provisioning_reconciler). Fix test fixtures to include the reconciliation marker rather than relying on hardcoded connector IDs. Prevent callers from adopting existing tenantless connectors during POST /api/source-ingest/connectors by failing closed with HTTP 403 TENANT_SCOPE_DENIED ('Connector has no bound tenant'). Verify all source_ingestion tests and test_service.py pass with fresh SOURCE_INGEST_DATA_DIR.

acceptance_verification.ac1_controller_owned_connector_ids_remov: passed: CONTROLLER_OWNED_CONNECTOR_IDS and its uses in _is_controller_owned and _fence_managed_connector_mutation are removed; controller ownership is determined solely by persona_source_reconciliation marker
acceptance_verification.ac2_marker_controller_token_fence_preser: passed: connectors carrying persona_source_reconciliation marker require controller authorization for configure, lifecycle, and schedule mutations
acceptance_verification.ac3_refuse_adopting_tenantless_connector: passed: configure_connector rejects mutations to existing non-controller connectors lacking tenant_id with 403 TENANT_SCOPE_DENIED ('Connector has no bound tenant') rather than allowing adoption
acceptance_verification.ac4_test_fixtures_use_marker: passed: test_tw_execution_alias_reads_only_the_official_twse_snapshot in test_latest_market_snapshot.py updated with persona_source_reconciliation marker
acceptance_verification.ac5_tests_and_hosted_readback: passed: services/source_ingestion/tests (1030 passed, 1 skipped) and services/source_ingestion/test_service.py (35 passed) pass with a fresh SOURCE_INGEST_DATA_DIR; hosted readback records existing marker evidence
acceptance_verification.ac6_exact_reviewed_head_ready: passed: scoped artifacts verified within line budget; ready for PR review and merge
